title: The Godfather
overview: The aging head of a New York crime family tries to hand his empire to his reluctant youngest son.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: Intertwined stories of two hitmen, a boxer and a crime boss's wife unfold in a darkly funny tour of Los Angeles.

title: The Shawshank Redemption

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ stumbles through decades of American history while never giving up on the woman he loves.

title: The Matrix

title: Fight Club

title: Taxi Driver
overview: A lonely night-shift cab driver in New York grows increasingly alienated and unstable.

title: Vertigo

title: Casablanca

title: Jaws

title: Schindler's List

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman faces the Joker, a chaotic criminal who pushes Gotham's heroes and citizens to their limits.

title: Inception

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel warrior flee a tyrant across a relentless chase.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a flashy space ranger toy becomes their owner's new favorite.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young drummer at an elite music school faces an abusive instructor who pushes him to the edge.
